baseline_reset_note: Package 14 recovery baseline. This snapshot is taken AFTER Tier 0s recovery (additive seed-list merge, Ashby/Greenhouse/Lever/Teamtailor re-verified live, 558 lost Ashby companies re-probed and restored) and Tier 3s postings fixes -- the first trustworthy reference point future runs should drift-compare against. Prior entries are left in this append-only file unedited, per this modules own no-hand-editing-history rule; this note is what marks the discontinuity for a future reader.
